Until it does, `cached_property.name` is the class's `None`, and `cached_property.func`, which `cached_property.__get__` calls, is a placeholder, a static method that raises `TypeError` (`django/utils/functional.py:cached_property`).

Called again with the same name, as when a subclass assigns the inherited descriptor to the same attribute, it does nothing; with another name it raises `TypeError` (`django/utils/functional.py:cached_property.__set_name__`).
Read on an instance, it calls `func` with the instance, writes the result into the instance's `__dict__` under the name, and returns it (`django/utils/functional.py:cached_property.__get__`).

`Options._expire_cache` deletes a name a model's options cache only where it finds it in the dictionary ([The options: what a model keeps as `_meta`](../models/options.md)) (`django/db/models/options.py:Options._expire_cache`).

`Query.clone` copies the query's `__dict__` and then pops `Query.base_table` with a default, and the clone works it out again ([The query: what a `Query` holds, and how it is copied](../query/anatomy.md)) (`django/db/models/sql/query.py:Query.clone`).
`cached_property.__get__` calls the function and stores its result with no lock (`django/utils/functional.py:cached_property.__get__`).

`classproperty.__get__` calls the function with the class it was read through, the class itself or an instance's class, and keeps nothing, so the function runs at every read (`django/utils/functional.py:classproperty`).

`MigrationRecorder.Migration` defines its model class at the first read and keeps it in `MigrationRecorder._migration_class` ([What has been applied: `MigrationRecorder` and the table `"django_migrations"`](../migrations/recorder.md)) (`django/db/migrations/recorder.py:MigrationRecorder.Migration`).
`View.view_is_async` is worked out at each read ([Asynchronous views](../views/async.md)) (`django/views/generic/base.py:View.view_is_async`).

`classonlymethod` is a `classmethod` whose `__get__` raises `AttributeError` when it is read through an instance, "This method is available only on the class, not on instances.", and otherwise binds to the class (`django/utils/decorators.py:classonlymethod`).
